fix.summary: Production-order enforcement is incomplete at target d73b6ebe. `canonicalizeLifecycleEvents` only checks `tool_execution_end.index < toolResult.index`; it can erase an out-of-order terminal that occurred before `tool_execution_start`. A target-equivalent dist probe with `issued → tool_execution_end → start → message_end/toolResult` returned an accepted Judge Receipt and audit observation after canonicalization removed the early terminal. This violates the required fail-closed handling for out-of-order events. Make the dual-representation exception require the complete production lifecycle order (so the dropped `tool_execution_end` is after the matching start), add this exact counterexample to the retained Recorder regression suite asserting null Receipt/audit, regenerate dist, and rerun the focused suite/typecheck/build consistency checks.

details.note: Review-005's zero-finding conclusion is not accepted for closure. Other historical findings were treated as discharged. Independent verification on an archive of d73b6ebe passed build source/dist identity, the 21-test focused suite, typecheck, and package inclusion; the remaining blocker is the reproducible ordering hole above.
